scripts.test: npm --prefix shared test && npm --prefix sync-gateway test && python -m pytest hq/tests -q
scripts.lint: eslint shared/src sync-gateway/src --ext .ts || echo "eslint not installed"
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p sync-gateway/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p field/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p hq-dashboard/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm --prefix shared run build && npm --prefix sync-gateway run build
scripts.verify: node scripts/m1_verify.mjs && node scripts/m2_verify.mjs && node scripts/m3_verify.mjs && node scripts/m4_verify.mjs && node scripts/m5_verify.mjs
scripts.verify:extreme: npm --prefix shared test && python -m pytest hq/tests -q && node scripts/dtn_verify.mjs && node scripts/snn_verify.mjs && node scripts/tracking_verify.mjs
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:extreme
